question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following figure series were to be continued? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c1fe724a6d95b39e8d724ef36a714e3af7c598c9528bea3d0207e3fef23d9ab.png]
solution:
The figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series is shown below:

1) For first box alternate series : 

 
• Alternately first column elements shifts in the anti-clockwise direction.
 
• Alternately second and third column elements shifts in the anti-clockwise direction. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ec27ee88983b63ce9116fe5324389f76027ba4963bf380e9b7b8a78d126c4db5.png] 

2) For second box alternate series :

 
• Alternately first row elements shifts in the clockwise direction.
 
• Alternately center left element and bottom right corner element interchange positions.
 
• Alternately center element is replaced by new element and remains constant i.e ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0c6815782bbef30a958fa13dd1223e752ec8323a96817b97eff800a6ad62b447.png] ' is replaced by ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f95977edefee430edf7d2706345c7b3e71037da4d2c0909c8d3a3e7660d7e47.png] ' and ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d4e089ad64adf5dc6d04a74f68d9b31bd81d670e8ffb090e6ecf64d79b1744ce.png] ' is replaced by ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f52c939e4db6884e3e4db5e5c6a424b188ee6ee47c1a2a2e321c0f732b91dc59.png] '.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2ecc1540ddf8955e84c10df8a57840bcc83f646818395aacd77080b4b23c0b10.png] 

The final series is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4803830bc01d1d229cfb211de5658c9c5b7d8a8147117a07ca1e91d24edf52e8.png] 

Hence, ‘option - (1)’ is the correct answer.
